content.title: CBI business group to name BAE Systems' Hogg as next president
content.summary: The CBI, Britain's best-known business lobbying group, will on Wednesday name Cressida Hogg, the BAE Systems chair, to take the helm until 2028.  Sky News has learnt that Ms Hogg, who also sits on the board of the London Stock Exchange's parent company, has been picked to succeed Rupert Soames as the CBI president early next year.  The appointment will make Ms Hogg a relative rarity as a woman holding the CBI's two-year presidency, and complete an all-female double act at the top of the organisation.
